bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
query="SELECT CASE WHEN (data->>'linkEditingRegistered')='true' THEN 'EDIT_OPEN' WHEN (data->>'linkEditingRegistered')='false' THEN 'RECEIPT' WHEN data ? 'shareCode' THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE 'MISSING' END FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='link' AND data->>'text'='個別編集済みの安全テスト';"
value="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$query")" || exit 61
case "$value" in EDIT_OPEN) exit 80;; RECEIPT) exit 81;; UNKNOWN) exit 82;; MISSING) exit 83;; *) exit 84;; esac
